note: Convention rules for the validate_snippet tool. Read by BOTH src/lib/server/mcp/snippet/rules.ts (hosted, static import) and mcp/snippet.ts (stdio, readFileSync) — the same shared-JSON pattern as patterns.registry.json; never import one runtime's engine into the other. Rules run per line; skipIf markers are checked against the matched line. {{COLOR_TOKENS}} is expanded at load time from src/app.css (--color-* names, longest first). The fixtures are the behavioral parity guard: the hosted engine test replays every one, and the stdio smoke run replays them against the live server.

rules.fix: Use the project primitive from $lib/components (Button, Input, Select, Textarea). Documented exceptions: hidden inputs, checkboxes in table rows, numeric-value selects, specialized interactive regions.

rules.message: Hardcoded color value — all colors come from the CSS custom-property tokens in app.css.
rules.fix: Use a design token (var(--color-*) in CSS, or the matching UnoCSS utility class).

rules.message: Named CSS color — all colors come from the design tokens in app.css.
rules.fix: Use a design token (var(--color-*) in CSS, or the matching UnoCSS utility class).

rules.message: Opacity modifier on a CSS-variable color token — UnoCSS cannot decompose the variable, so this renders at FULL opacity.
rules.fix: Use scoped CSS instead: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-x) NN%, transparent).

rules.message: Svelte 4 prop declaration — this project is Svelte 5 runes only.
rules.fix: Declare props with $props(): let { name = fallback } = $props();

rules.message: Svelte 4 reactive statement — this project is Svelte 5 runes only.
rules.fix: Use $derived for derived values or $effect for side effects.

rules.message: svelte/store import — new code uses Svelte 5 runes, not stores.
rules.fix: Use $state (shared via a .svelte.ts module when cross-component) instead of writable/readable stores.

rules.message: Svelte 4 event directive — Svelte 5 uses plain event attributes.
rules.fix: Replace on:click={...} with onclick={...} (same for other events).

rules.message: Zod import — validation in this project is Valibot v1 (+ Superforms for forms).
rules.fix: Use valibot: import * as v from 'valibot'; schemas compose with v.object/v.string/etc.

rules.message: A prop named `state` collides with the $state rune (store_invalid_shape at runtime).
rules.fix: Rename the prop — e.g. `status`, `phase`, or a domain-specific name.
